scope: 45 frontier titles: fighting, ecology and war. Offline actual-engine and independent minimal-DOM callback checks only. Production read-only; no browser, network or publishing.

independentAssertions.terminalGoals: Independent numeric/property goals, not builder proof flags. Legal actions and transition invariants checked throughout each witness; prefixes cannot independently satisfy terminal goals.
independentAssertions.scenarioDiversity: 100 anonymous full-horizon ecological behavioral signatures/title,100 unlabeled non-isomorphic war tree maps/title,100 actual fighting collision-layout signatures/title after reflections/axis normalization.
independentAssertions.ai: All three fighting and war tiers have different decision-only traces and obey documented observations. All five ecology policies respond to observations at all three tiers, with actual runtime consequences. Current/future human order and hidden extra data tests passed.
independentAssertions.physicsAndMechanics: Every fighting title has an independent concrete collision/weapon/temporal mechanism counterfactual. War and ecology titles each have independent causal subsystem probes.
independentAssertions.controls: Actual mounted callbacks exercised in an independent minimum DOM harness. Every witness input fits public controls;90 sample missions replayed through public UI callbacks. Fighting includes explicit precision stepping, pointer cancellation/outside release, keyboard blur, and page restoration loop tests.
independentAssertions.persistence: Malformed inputs recover/reject safely in sampled cases; assistance survives reload and certified challenge policy scope is enforced.
independentAssertions.antiSpam: All6000 independent fighting policy runs completed: idle and chase-primary win0 levels; no tested all-button/cycling policy wins all100 levels of any title. Max tested policy wins90/100. War wait/recruit-only policies never meet a full challenge.
independentAssertions.ecologyConservation: All mycelium witness transitions independently conserve host water plus finite groundwater after rain and consumption. Island/intertidal lineages cannot recover after extinction; valid regenerated witnesses remain alive.

resolvedFindings.problem: Island, predator and social easy policies originally ignored observed state.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Weaker observation-dependent policies now produce causal tier differences.

resolvedFindings.problem: Mycelium water transfer originally created water without a finite source.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Bounded soil reservoir, explicit extraction/consumption accounts, visible reservoir and conservation assertions.

resolvedFindings.problem: Two island proofs and one intertidal proof resurrected extinct populations.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Extinction is absorbing; affected corpora/proofs regenerated. Plant health explicitly describes reversible stress of living roots.

resolvedFindings.problem: Capitalless challenge was lost immediately if original node0 fell.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Network challenge continues with other command councils; origin-loss continuation and independent council victory rechecked. Builder final source-bound regression report includes10 cases.

resolvedFindings.problem: Layer/rail text claimed underground supply cutting and disconnected frontline tax effects absent from the engine.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final UI/README scope matches actual cross-layer reinforcements and rail-connected recruitment/supply.

caveats: No real-browser rendering, mobile geometry, touch hardware or hosted deployment QA was performed by this audit.
Witnesses prove existence against the documented fixed training/normal challenge policies. They do not prove unique solutions or forced wins against arbitrary opponents.
Difficulty decisions and information limits are verified; monotonically stronger win rates for every opponent style are not claimed.
Ecology models remain explicitly simplified game abstractions, not scientific forecasting.
Finite sampled negative policies and counterfactuals do not constitute exhaustive verification of every possible control sequence.
